metadata.question: What is Spotify's monthly active user count?

response.summary: As of December 31, 2025, Spotify's monthly active user (MAU) count is 751 million. This represents an 11% increase from the previous year (2024) when the MAU count was 675 million (Source 1: Spotify Annual Report 20-F, p.45; Source 2: Spotify Annual Report 20-F, p.49).
